newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks bounce higher, recover from tax scare.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks bounce higher, recover from tax scare.

text.p: Tokyo stocks bounced higher on Tuesday, propelled by buy-backs following a tumble of over three percent the previous day which was triggered by a government official's remarks about the possibility of a further rise in the national sales tax.
The 225-share Nikkei average finished 395.79 points or 2.19 percent higher at 18,439.61. Its June futures were 350 points higher at 18,440.
"Tokyo stocks jumped the gun on Monday," Toyo Securities director, Haruo Nakaharu, said. "Strong U.S. markets overnight and clarification of the comment helped bring a recovery."
